nim_code:
import strutils, streams, math

proc insertToc(filePath: string) =
  var lines: seq[string] = @[]
  var toc: seq[string] = @[]
  
  var fsIn = newFileStream(filePath, fmRead)
  if fsIn.isNil: return
  
  for line in fsIn.lines():
    lines.add(line)
    if line.startsWith("##") and " " in line:
      let parts = line.split(" ", 1)
      let hashes = parts[0]
      let title = parts[1].strip()
      let indent = repeat("  ", hashes.len - 2)
      let link = title.toLowerAscii().replace(" ", "-")
      toc.add(indent & "- [" & title & "](#" & link & ")")
      
  fsIn.close()
  
  var fsOut = newFileStream(filePath, fmWrite)
  if fsOut.isNil: return
  defer: fsOut.close()
  
  var inserted = false
  for line in lines:
    fsOut.writeLine(line)
    if not inserted and line.startsWith("# "):
      fsOut.writeLine("")
      fsOut.writeLine("## Table of Contents")
      for tItem in toc:
        fsOut.writeLine(tItem)
      fsOut.writeLine("")
      inserted = true

when isMainModule:
  let f = "test_doc.md"
  writeFile(f, """# Main Title
Intro text here.
## Section 1
Content 1
### Subsection A
More content
## Section 2
Final words
""")
  insertToc(f)
  echo readFile(f)

  removeFile(f)

import strutils, sequtils, algorithm

type
  User = object
    id: int
    name: string
    role: string

proc escapeCsvField(field: string): string =
  if ',' in field or '"' in field or '\n' in field:
    return "\"" & field.replace("\"", "\"\"") & "\""
  return field

proc usersToCsv(users: seq[User]): string =

proc generatePassword(length: int, useNums, useSyms: bool): string =
  var chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
  if useNums: chars &= "0123456789"

  var res = ""
  for _ in 1..length:
    res.add(sample(chars))
  return res

proc validateAndGen(length: int, useNums, useSyms: bool): JsonNode =
  let pwd = generatePassword(length, useNums, useSyms)
  
  var hasNum = false
  var hasSym = false
  for c in pwd:

  if useNums and not hasNum: valid = false
  if useSyms and not hasSym: valid = false

  j["valid"] = %valid
  return j

nim_code:
import strutils, json, math

type
  TokenType = enum Number, Operator
  Token = object
    kind: TokenType
    value: string

proc lexMath(expr: string): JsonNode =
  var tokens: seq[Token] = @[]
  var i = 0
  
  while i < expr.len:
    if expr[i] in Whitespace:
      inc i
      continue
      
    if expr[i] in {'0'..'9', '.'}:
      var numStr = ""
      while i < expr.len and expr[i] in {'0'..'9', '.'}:
        numStr.add(expr[i])
        inc i
      tokens.add(Token(kind: Number, value: numStr))
    elif expr[i] in {'+', '-', '*', '/', '(', ')'}:
      tokens.add(Token(kind: Operator, value: $expr[i]))
      inc i
    else:
      # Ignore unknown chars for simplicity
      inc i
      
  var j = newJArray()
  for t in tokens:
    var tObj = newJObject()
    tObj["type"] = %($t.kind)
    tObj["value"] = %t.value
    j.add(tObj)
    
  return j

when isMainModule:
  let e = "3.14 + (2 * 8) - 1"
  echo lexMath(e).pretty()

import strutils, times, streams, os

proc summarizeLogErrors(logFile: string) =
  var fs = newFileStream(logFile, fmRead)
  if fs.isNil: return
  defer: fs.close()
  
  var firstTime, lastTime: DateTime
  var hasFirst = false
  var errorCount = 0
  
  for line in fs.lines():
    if "ERROR" in line:
      let parts = line.split("]", 1)
      if parts.len == 2 and parts[0].startsWith("["):
        let tsStr = parts[0][1..^1]
        try:
          let dt = parse(tsStr, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
          if not hasFirst:
            firstTime = dt
            hasFirst = true
          lastTime = dt
          inc errorCount
        except TimeParseError:
          discard
          
  echo "Total Errors: ", errorCount
  if hasFirst:
    let duration = lastTime - firstTime
    echo "Time span: ", duration

  writeFile(f, """[2023-11-01 10:00:00] ERROR Out of memory
[2023-11-01 10:05:00] INFO OK

""")

import json, math, strutils

type BloomFilter = object
  bits: seq[bool]
  size: int

proc initBloom(size: int): BloomFilter =
  result.size = size
  result.bits = newSeq[bool](size)

proc hash1(s: string): int =
  var h = 0
  for c in s: h = (h * 31 + ord(c)) mod 9999991
  return h

proc hash2(s: string): int =
  var h = 5381
  for c in s: h = ((h shl 5) + h) + ord(c)
  return abs(h)

proc hash3(s: string): int =
  var h = 0
  for i, c in s: h += ord(c) * (i + 1)
  return h

proc add(bf: var BloomFilter, item: string) =
  bf.bits[hash1(item) mod bf.size] = true
  bf.bits[hash2(item) mod bf.size] = true
  bf.bits[hash3(item) mod bf.size] = true

proc contains(bf: BloomFilter, item: string): bool =
  if not bf.bits[hash1(item) mod bf.size]: return false
  if not bf.bits[hash2(item) mod bf.size]: return false
  if not bf.bits[hash3(item) mod bf.size]: return false
  return true

proc testBloomFilter(itemsToAdd, itemsToTest: seq[string]): string =
  var bf = initBloom(100)
  for item in itemsToAdd: bf.add(item)
  
  var jRes = newJObject()
  for item in itemsToTest:
    jRes[item] = %(bf.contains(item))
    
  return jRes.pretty()

import times, json, os

type TokenBucket = object
  capacity: float
  refillRate: float
  tokens: float
  lastCheck: Time

proc initBucket(cap, rate: float): TokenBucket =
  result.capacity = cap
  result.refillRate = rate
  result.tokens = cap
  result.lastCheck = getTime()

proc consume(tb: var TokenBucket, amount: float): bool =
  let now = getTime()
  let elapsed = now - tb.lastCheck
  let elapsedSecs = float(elapsed.inMilliseconds) / 1000.0
  
  tb.tokens += elapsedSecs * tb.refillRate
  if tb.tokens > tb.capacity: tb.tokens = tb.capacity
  tb.lastCheck = now
  
  if tb.tokens >= amount:
    tb.tokens -= amount
    return true
  return false

proc simulateTraffic(cfgJson: string): string =
  let cfg = parseJson(cfgJson)
  var bucket = initBucket(cfg["capacity"].getFloat(), cfg["refill_rate"].getFloat())
  
  var jArr = newJArray()
  # Simulate 3 fast requests
  for i in 1..3:
    let allowed = bucket.consume(1.0)
    var r = newJObject()
    r["req"] = %i
    r["allowed"] = %allowed
    jArr.add(r)

proc formatSize(bytes: int64): string =
  let b = float(bytes)
  if b < 1024: return $bytes & " B"
  elif b < 1024 * 1024: return formatFloat(b / 1024, ffDecimal, 2) & " KB"
  elif b < 1024 * 1024 * 1024: return formatFloat(b / (1024 * 1024), ffDecimal, 2) & " MB"
  else: return formatFloat(b / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), ffDecimal, 2) & " GB"

proc analyzeDiskUsage(dir: string): string =

    let key = if ext.len > 0: ext else: "no_extension"

  return res

proc measureLatency(url: string, count: int): string =
  var client = newHttpClient()

  for _ in 1..count:
    let start = cpuTime()
    try:
      discard client.request(url, HttpHead)
      let duration = cpuTime() - start
      latencies.add(duration * 1000.0) # ms

      continue

  var minL = latencies[0]
  var maxL = latencies[0]

    if l > maxL: maxL = l
    sumL += l

proc simulateGrep(args: seq[string]): string =

    of cmdArgument:

      else: files.add(key)
    of cmdLongOption, cmdShortOption:
      if key == "i" or key == "ignore-case":
        ignoreCase = true
    of cmdEnd: discard
    
  if pattern == "" or files.len == 0:
    return "Usage: grep [-i] pattern file1 file2..."
    
  var res = ""
  let searchPat = if ignoreCase: pattern.toLowerAscii() else: pattern
  
  for f in files:
    var fs = newFileStream(f, fmRead)
    if not fs.isNil:
      var lineNum = 1
      var line = ""
      while fs.readLine(line):
        let target = if ignoreCase: line.toLowerAscii() else: line
        if target.find(searchPat) != -1:
          res &= f & ":" & $lineNum & ":" & line & "\n"
        inc lineNum
      fs.close()

import streams, strutils, times, os

proc filterLogs(inPath: string) =
  var fsIn = newFileStream(inPath, fmRead)
  if fsIn.isNil: return
  defer: fsIn.close()
  
  let outPath = "filtered_" & getTime().format("yyyyMMdd") & ".log"
  var fsOut = newFileStream(outPath, fmWrite)
  if fsOut.isNil: return
  defer: fsOut.close()
  
  var line = ""
  while fsIn.readLine(line):
    if "WARN" in line or "ERROR" in line:
      fsOut.writeLine(line)

when isMainModule:
  let f = "test.log"
  writeFile(f, "INFO OK\nWARN memory high\nERROR crashed")
  filterLogs(f)
  let outF = "filtered_" & getTime().format("yyyyMMdd") & ".log"
  echo readFile(outF)
  removeFile(f)
  removeFile(outF)
